steps.caption: The Pipeline
steps.narration: This is the Pipeline in the ConstructHUB CRM. Every job is a card, and every column is a stage.

steps.caption: Prospect
steps.narration: The stages are in groups. Prospect comes first, with your leads.

steps.caption: The Lead stage
steps.narration: The number beside a stage is how many jobs are in it.

steps.caption: A card
steps.narration: A card shows the job's name, its project number and its trades.

steps.caption: Sales
steps.narration: Sales is next: Estimating, Proposal Sent and Approved.

steps.caption: Contract value
steps.narration: When a job has a contract value, the card shows it.

steps.caption: Production
steps.narration: Production follows the work, from Scheduled through In Progress.

steps.caption: Later stages
steps.narration: Scroll sideways for the later stages, like Punch List and Complete.

steps.caption: Billing
steps.narration: Billing holds the jobs that are invoiced and paid.

steps.caption: Open a job
steps.chapter: Open a job or move it
steps.narration: Click a job's name to open its project page.

steps.caption: The project page
steps.narration: The project page has the contract, the costs and the job's tabs.

steps.caption: The stage menu
steps.narration: The menu on each card moves the job to another stage.

steps.caption: New lead
steps.narration: And New lead adds a job to the first stage.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: You'll find the Pipeline in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to read the pipeline board | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Pipeline in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see how stages are grouped into Prospect, Sales, Production and Billing, what each job card shows, and how to open a job from the board.
